description.description: A Japanese document listing various medical terms and conditions, appearing to be an adverse event report related to pharmacological studies. The text consists of a dense list of symptoms, diseases, and medical jargon separated by semicolons, highlighted in light grey sections.

A document titled BNT162b2, Section 5.3.6 Cumulative Analysis of Post-authorization Adverse Event Reports. The page contains a long, alphabetical list of medical conditions, mostly ranging from 'fasciitis' to 'Herpes virus'. The footer marks it as CONFIDENTIAL Page 4, with an FDA identification number FDA-CBER-2021-5683-0000086 and a secondary page number 33.
